❓ 145 OSS/IN Training & Readiness Tracker — Quick Guide

Recommended workflow for drill weekends, readiness reviews, and flight administration

📌 Purpose and Source Data:
Use this tracker to organize and review flight training readiness. It is an offline working tool, not a live database. Start each update by setting the As-Of Date, then import the latest Monthly OSS Tracker and BCET data and scan applicable training certificates. Confirm discrepancies against the authoritative source records before making final updates.

⚠️ Save the Working Copy: Changes remain in the current browser session until you select “💾 Save / Share HTML” and/or “📥 Export BCET”. Save the updated file and obtain permission from the Shop SUP, Internal Training Manager, or Unit Intelligence Professional before replacing a shared working copy.

📅 1. Set the As-Of Date

Set the date used for the readiness calculation before reviewing the board. The tracker uses this date to identify overdue items, tasks due within the next 30 calendar days, and the blue ≤60-day watch category.

📂 2. Import Source Trackers

Select “📂 Upload OSS / BCET” to import the latest Monthly OSS Tracker and/or unit BCET.xlsx. This refreshes available Fitness (PFRA), Medical (IMR), EPB/OPB, Admin, Ancillary, Shop ITE, and Letter of X data.

🎓 3. Scan Training Certificates

Select “🎓 Scan Certs Folder” and choose the applicable certificate folder. The tracker matches supported certificate names to members and tasks, then updates completion and due dates when a newer certificate is found.

🔎 4. Review Readiness

Use Spotlight for the flight-level view, Member Cards for individual summaries, Check-Off Matrix for task-level updates, and Letter of X to review qualification information. Use the filters to focus on a member, category, or readiness status.

☑️ 5. Update Items Deliberately

Open a member record to check off completed training, enter accomplished or due dates, and add notes. Verify task completion and dates against the source record before saving; checking a completed task recalculates the next due date when a standard interval applies.

💾 6. Save and Export

Select “💾 Save / Share HTML” to create the updated tracker file. Select “📥 Export BCET” when an updated Excel copy is needed. Preserve the approved working version and follow unit procedures for upload, overwrite, records retention, and distribution.
